model.title: A resolution to constitute the majority party's membership on certain committees for the One Hundred Nineteenth Congress, or until their successors are chosen.

summary.text: The resolution would establish which members of the majority party serve on various congressional committees for the upcoming legislative session. It sets the party membership rosters for these committees until new members are selected to replace them.
